intent.summary: Invokes one discrete user action when activated.
useWhen: A user intentionally triggers an immediate command
avoidWhen: The interaction selects persistent state or navigates without command semantics

semantics.childPolicy: one label subtree describing the action
semantics.sizing: at least the platform-independent minimum target; expands for label and padding

attributes.name: action
attributes.description: Command invoked exactly once per activation.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Visible label subtree with an unambiguous accessible name.

attributes.name: prominence
attributes.description: Relative emphasis within the surrounding action set.

attributes.name: isDefault
attributes.description: Whether the action is the scope's default keyboard action.

constraints.expression: label has a non-empty accessible name
constraints.message: Every button requires an unambiguous action name.

accessibility.focusBehavior: focusable when enabled; operable by primary activation keys
notes: Expose disabled, default, pressed, or expanded state when applicable.

mappings.strategy: Separate action closure, label subtree, role, and enabled state.
Select the control from command and navigation semantics, not appearance alone.
